providers.name: CleanTender

pricing.plansText: Radar: free forever. Pro: £99/month or £990/year. Pro includes 30 AI compliance evaluations per month, unlimited AI bid drafting subject to fair-use rate limits, the Social Value Generator, Compliance Vault and matching email alerts.
pricing.seatDetail: Pro is priced per company. One subscription covers the whole bid team and the provider says it does not gate seats; no additional-seat price is stated.
pricing.trialDetail: The ongoing Radar free tier serves as the trial, includes one AI compliance scan per month, requires no card and has no time limit.

comparablePlans.notes: Free forever; one AI compliance evaluation per month, company profile and live tender listings. No annual billing option is published.

comparablePlans.includedUsers: Whole bid team; provider says seats are not gated
comparablePlans.notes: Prices exclude VAT. Includes 30 AI compliance evaluations per month and unlimited bid drafting subject to fair-use rate limits.

keywordAlerts.detail: Alerts are documented as profile-based filters using sectors, regions, value bands and a match-score threshold; user-defined keyword alerts are not stated.

semanticAiMatching.detail: Pro alerts are scored against a stored company profile and threshold, while the AI evaluator compares contract packs with more than 30 profile fields. Alert access and scan volume vary by plan.

buyerProfiles.detail: Structured contracting-authority profiles or buyer intelligence are not stated on the reviewed product pages.

supplierProfiles.detail: The product has a user's own company compliance profile, which does not meet this schema's supplier-profile definition. A public Verified Supplier Directory is explicitly marked coming soon rather than available.

renewalSignals.detail: The Compliance Vault tracks the customer's certificate and policy expiry dates, but contract expiry, renewal or re-tender monitoring is not stated.

similarContracts.detail: Public contract records include a Browse similar tenders route and surface other open opportunities in the same sector or from the same buyer.

buyerDocuments.detail: The AI evaluator loads and reads the selected tender's full contract pack. Wider buyer-authored plans, strategies, minutes, budgets or pipelines are not stated.

buyerRequirements.detail: The plan-limited compliance evaluator reads tender requirements and organises insurance, accreditation, policy, experience and other gaps by severity.

requirementsPlanning.detail: The compliance evaluator produces a structured gap list and submission checklist, but scans are limited by plan and month.

awardHistory.detail: Historical award notices, supplier winners, award values or a dedicated award search are not stated on the reviewed product pages.

frameworks.detail: The tender directory contains individual framework opportunities, but a dedicated framework, DPS or dynamic-market intelligence tool is not stated.

competitorTracking.detail: Named competitor, incumbent, supplier or winner monitoring is not stated on the reviewed product pages.

exportsApi.detail: Pro bid drafts can be exported to Word, PDF, Markdown or plain text. Tender-data export, API, webhook and CRM integration are not stated.

collaboration.detail: One Pro company subscription covers the whole bid team and the company profile and documents are shared. Assignments, comments and a shared bid pipeline are not stated.

bidWriting.detail: Pro generates editable, exportable Selection Questionnaire and Social Value drafts using the company profile and contract pack; the free tier does not include bid drafting.

explicitPortals.detail: CleanTender's live contract records explicitly identify Find a Tender Service as their source.
CleanTender's live contract records explicitly identify Contracts Finder as their source.

otherCoverageClaims.claim: The provider describes a real-time UK public-sector Soft FM directory covering cleaning, security, grounds, waste, catering, pest control, laundry, reception and integrated-FM bundles, curated from official UK sources.

caveats: The source, AI scoring and drafting claims are provider-stated and have not been independently tested by Civensa.
Coverage is intentionally limited to Soft FM and adjacent categories rather than all procurement sectors.

Only Find a Tender and Contracts Finder were explicitly evidenced as product sources in the reviewed first-party records; educational articles that merely describe other portals were not counted as product coverage.
AI evaluations and generated drafts are decision-support outputs, not buyer decisions or a substitute for reading the tender documents.

providers.name: Contract Finder Pro

pricing.plansText: Core Platform yearly prices: Basic £690/year; Professional £990/year; Enterprise from £1,960/year. Analytics and Tender Ninja pricing is quote-only.
pricing.seatDetail: Professional is described for teams and Enterprise includes 3+ user licences. The Basic user allowance and additional-user price are not publicly stated.
pricing.vatDetail: Core Platform prices are stated as plus VAT.
pricing.trialDetail: A 14-day Core trial with full platform access is advertised. The first-party registration page requires payment-card details and says the first payment is taken after the trial unless cancelled.

comparablePlans.notes: Plus VAT. A monthly subscription is referenced, but no numeric monthly price was established on the reviewed first-party pages.

comparablePlans.includedUsers: Described for teams; exact allowance is not publicly stated
comparablePlans.notes: Plus VAT. The page associates 3+ users with team and enterprise copy but does not publish an additional-seat price.
Starting annual price, plus VAT. Custom integrations, onboarding, support and SLA are advertised.
Separately priced modular product; contact the provider for a quote.
Can be bought as a standalone modular product; contact the provider for a quote.

keywordAlerts.detail: Core provides tailored daily alerts, urgent flash emails, unlimited searches and CPV-code and keyword filtering.

semanticAiMatching.detail: The reviewed pages document keyword, CPV and natural-language search, but do not establish semantic or profile-based automatic relevance matching.

buyerProfiles.detail: Professional includes Buyer Behaviour Analysis, while the separately priced Analytics buyer dashboard covers pipelines, procurement methods, supplier relationships, tender windows, durations and contacts. Canonicalisation, deduplication or entity-resolution handling is not established.

supplierProfiles.detail: The separately priced Analytics supplier dashboard provides structured supplier activity, award history, buyer relationships and Companies House context for competitors or potential partners. Canonicalisation, deduplication or entity-resolution handling is not established.

renewalSignals.detail: The separately priced Analytics Opportunities dashboard includes upcoming renewals and supports a forward pipeline.

similarContracts.detail: The provider offers a multi-million-record historical database and Analytics search across lifecycle stage, source, value, duration, location, CPV and natural-language queries. Automatic similar-contract surfacing beside each notice is not stated.

buyerDocuments.detail: Tender Ninja can ingest uploaded ITT, PQQ or RFP documents and extract their questions. Wider buyer plans, strategies, minutes, budgets or pipelines as documents are not stated.

buyerRequirements.detail: Tender Ninja extracts questions from buyer tender documents, creates an estimated scoring rubric and assesses responses against evaluation criteria; it is a separately priced module.

requirementsPlanning.detail: Tender Ninja storyboards complex answers, flags weak attribution and identifies response gaps against its scoring rubric; it is a separately priced module rather than a Core feature.

awardHistory.detail: Professional includes a weekly awards email, and Analytics exposes contract-award history and supplier-buyer relationships.

frameworks.detail: Professional includes a Framework and DPS Tracker, and Analytics search includes framework and DPS records.

competitorTracking.detail: Professional includes Competitor Analysis; Analytics can research supplier activity, buyer relationships and award history.

exportsApi.detail: Enterprise advertises custom integrations and Tender Ninja can export a full bid. A public tender-data API or standard Core CSV/Excel export is not stated.

collaboration.detail: Tender Ninja supports multiple people collaborating on storyboards and responses. Team licences and custom integrations vary by plan.

bidWriting.detail: Separately priced Tender Ninja uploads tender documents, extracts questions, drafts from a company knowledge base, storyboards, source-traces, scores and exports responses.

explicitPortals.detail: The current pricing FAQ names Find a Tender and says another 200-plus local-authority and sector portals are covered.
The provider's first-party beta product page names Contracts Finder alongside Find a Tender as an example of the UK portals searched.

otherCoverageClaims.claim: The provider claims all UK and Ireland public-sector portals and more than 200 additional local-authority and sector-specific portals.

caveats: The coverage, database-size, analytics and AI claims are provider-stated and have not been independently tested by Civensa.
Only Find a Tender and Contracts Finder were explicitly named in the reviewed first-party pages; the remaining 200-plus claimed portals are not listed source by source.
Analytics and Tender Ninja are modular products with quote-only pricing and should not be treated as included in every Core subscription.
The provider uses both 2 million-plus and 5 million-plus database-size claims across current pages; the exact corpus definition should be confirmed.

providers.name: Contracts Advance

pricing.plansText: Current software pricing: Search £1,399 for 1 year, £2,599 for 2 years or £3,799 for 3 years; Discover £2,099, £3,699 or £5,099 respectively; Explore £2,999, £4,999 or £7,299 respectively. Separate bid reviews: £750 for one day or £1,495 for two days.
pricing.seatDetail: A detailed live software page says unlimited users, while the current pricing page does not state a user allowance or additional-seat price. Confirm the unlimited-user term because the detailed page also displays older plan prices.
pricing.trialDetail: A free-trial link is present, but trial length and payment-card requirement are not publicly stated on the reviewed pages.

comparablePlans.includedUsers: Unlimited users claimed on a separate live software page; current pricing page does not state user limits
comparablePlans.notes: Excludes VAT. Current totals: £1,399 for one year, £2,599 for two years and £3,799 for three years. Multi-year totals are preserved here rather than converted into invented annual prices.

comparablePlans.includedUsers: Unlimited users claimed on a separate live software page; current pricing page does not state user limits
comparablePlans.notes: Excludes VAT. Current totals: £2,099 for one year, £3,699 for two years and £5,099 for three years. Multi-year totals are not converted into annual prices.

comparablePlans.includedUsers: Unlimited users claimed on a separate live software page; current pricing page does not state user limits
comparablePlans.notes: Excludes VAT. Current totals: £2,999 for one year, £4,999 for two years and £7,299 for three years. Multi-year totals are not converted into annual prices.

keywordAlerts.detail: The provider documents tailored daily tender emails and powerful searches, but does not explicitly state that alerts are configured by saved keywords.

semanticAiMatching.detail: Semantic, machine-learning, AI or supplier-profile relevance matching is not stated on the reviewed product pages.

buyerProfiles.detail: Explore includes structured Buyer Analysis with named contacts, previous suppliers, financial values and procurement-market insight; lower plans do not list it, and canonicalisation, deduplication or entity-resolution handling is not established.

supplierProfiles.detail: Explore provides structured competitor analysis with prior awardees, current public contracts and comparative market context. Lower plans do not list it, and canonicalisation, deduplication or entity-resolution handling is not established.

renewalSignals.detail: Discover and Explore include Active Contracts and identify likely re-tenders using current holder, supplied goods or services, financial value and expected date to market.

similarContracts.detail: Explore's Market Analysis displays award notices for products or services similar to the customer's offering and the competitors awarded them.

buyerDocuments.detail: The detailed live product page lists integrated FOI requesting on Discover and Explore. It does not state a ready-made library of buyer plans, strategies, minutes, budgets or other buyer documents.

buyerRequirements.detail: Extraction or organisation of participation conditions, certifications, policies, evaluation criteria or recurring buyer requirements is not stated on the reviewed product pages.

requirementsPlanning.detail: The product supports pipeline and resource planning for likely re-tenders, but a requirements-readiness, evidence-gap or compliance-planning workflow is not stated.

awardHistory.detail: Explore's Market Analysis displays contract award notices and previous suppliers; lower plans do not list this analysis.

frameworks.detail: Dedicated framework, DPS or dynamic-market discovery or intelligence is not stated on the reviewed product pages.

competitorTracking.detail: Explore includes Competitor Analysis showing current contract holders and prior awardees, while lower plans do not list it.

exportsApi.detail: The current pricing table lists Fully Exportable Data on Search, Discover and Explore. Export format, API, webhook and CRM support are not publicly specified.

collaboration.detail: A detailed live software page states unlimited user access for the whole team. Assignments, shared notes and other in-product collaboration mechanics are not stated.

bidWriting.detail: Bid reviews, bid writing and bespoke consultancy are offered separately through a trusted partner rather than described as included software functionality.

otherCoverageClaims.claim: The provider says its software provides complete visibility of public-sector opportunities from every available source and all tenders published on an open-sourced procurement portal.

caveats: The coverage, relevance, re-tender, buyer and competitor claims are provider-stated and have not been independently tested by Civensa.
No complete named portal list is published on the reviewed product pages; the provider offers a free portal audit for customer-supplied mission-critical portal lists.

The detailed live software page displays older plan prices than the current pricing page. Current pricing was used, while its unlimited-user and feature details should be reconfirmed before publication.
Likely re-tender dates are signals derived from active-contract information, not confirmed future procurements.

providers.name: D3 Tenders

pricing.plansText: Free: £0/month for registered charities, VCSEs, CICs and suppliers before their first public-sector win, with Scale access. Paid annual-billing rates: Essentials £79/month (£948/year), Growth £240/month (£2,880/year), Scale £360/month (£4,320/year), Managed from £840/month (£10,080/year). Monthly billing is available, but the non-annual prices are not shown on the main pricing table.
pricing.seatDetail: Every displayed plan includes up to 25 team licences with no per-seat fees. Custom Enterprise terms are mentioned in comparison copy but no public Enterprise price is shown.
pricing.vatDetail: VAT treatment is not publicly stated on the reviewed pricing page.
pricing.trialDetail: Premium advertises a 7-day free trial with no commitment. A payment-card requirement is not publicly stated. The eligibility-based Free plan is separate and continues until the first win or while eligible as a charity, VCSE or CIC.

comparablePlans.notes: Eligibility-based Scale access for registered charities, VCSEs, CICs and suppliers before their first public-sector win.
The displayed £79/month is the equivalent for £948 billed annually. Monthly billing is said to be available, but its numeric price is not published on the reviewed page. VAT is not stated.
The displayed £240/month is the equivalent for £2,880 billed annually. Numeric monthly-billing price and VAT treatment are not published.
The displayed £360/month is the equivalent for £4,320 billed annually. Numeric monthly-billing price and VAT treatment are not published.
Starting annual total. The displayed £840/month is the equivalent for £10,080 billed annually. Numeric monthly-billing price and VAT treatment are not published.

keywordAlerts.detail: Feed Builder supports editable keywords, smart filters, saved searches and daily or weekly email digests configurable by team member.

semanticAiMatching.detail: Feed Builder analyses a website or plain-English business description, extracts capabilities and matching criteria, and expands keywords with AI synonyms. The pricing comparison lists the advanced Trained Search Model only on Free-eligible Scale access, Scale and Managed.

buyerProfiles.detail: Buyer Intelligence provides structured cross-notice metrics, annual spend, supplier count, live opportunities, award details, supplier relationships and purchasing patterns. The provider does not establish canonicalisation, deduplication or entity resolution for the Premium buyer profiles.

supplierProfiles.detail: Supplier intelligence includes structured league tables, award volume and value, buyer relationships, engagement and churn indicators, and contract history. The provider does not establish canonicalisation, deduplication or entity resolution for these Premium supplier profiles.

renewalSignals.detail: The platform advertises Upcoming Contracts, forward pipeline, planning-stage notices and ten years of history for trends and recompetes.

similarContracts.detail: Know Your Market supports finding who won similar work before and analysing ten years of contract and award history by buyer, supplier, sector and value.

buyerDocuments.detail: Buyer plans, strategies, minutes, budgets or other buyer-authored documents beyond procurement notices are not stated on the reviewed product pages.

buyerRequirements.detail: The separately delivered bid-writing service analyses tender requirements, evaluation criteria and buyer priorities. Comparable structured extraction is not stated as a self-serve Premium feature.

requirementsPlanning.detail: Separate Readiness Audits and consultancy identify gaps in policies, insurance, certifications and documentation; this is an expert service rather than a stated self-serve Premium workflow.

awardHistory.detail: Find Tenders includes award-stage records, and Know Your Market exposes every contract award with date, value and supplier filtering plus buyer and supplier histories.

frameworks.detail: The search product includes framework agreements, framework call-offs and dynamic-market notices across procurement stages.

competitorTracking.detail: Competitor Analysis researches and benchmarks suppliers by sector, location, contract type, award volume and value, buyer relationships and contract history.

exportsApi.detail: The separately scoped Data Hub offers per-record JSON, JSON/CSV/XML or custom bulk delivery, REST APIs, real-time feeds, custom enrichment and webhooks; these are not stated as included in every subscription plan.

collaboration.detail: Plans include up to 25 team members. Users can collaborate on shortlists, share notes, assign opportunities, comment, track activity and work in shared pipelines and calendars.

bidWriting.detail: D3 offers professional tender analysis, bid writing, review and full bid-management services. Self-serve AI response drafting or an answer library is not stated as a Premium software feature.

explicitPortals.detail: The provider explicitly says it aggregates Contracts Finder data.
The provider explicitly says it aggregates Find a Tender, also labelled FTS.
The provider explicitly says it aggregates Public Contracts Scotland data.
The provider explicitly says it aggregates Sell2Wales data.

otherCoverageClaims.claim: The provider describes coverage as every UK portal, all major UK procurement portals and complete UK data, unified from four UK sources.

caveats: The coverage, matching, intelligence and service claims are provider-stated and have not been independently tested by Civensa.
Although the provider says every UK portal, its reviewed source list names four portals and does not name eTendersNI or individual local, sector and buyer portals.
Free access is eligibility-based rather than a universally available permanent free plan: charities, VCSEs, CICs and suppliers before their first public-sector win qualify.
Readiness audits, bid writing and Data Hub/API delivery are separate services and should not be presented as included in every Premium subscription.

The Custom API service can add entity resolution as bespoke enrichment, but the provider does not establish that Premium buyer and supplier profiles use canonicalised or entity-resolved organisations.
Upcoming contracts and recompete signals are forward-looking intelligence, not confirmed future procurements.
